reasons: Both answers correct the forum, explain the mandatory 30-day pretenziya and list the right attachments, so the rubric does not separate them. The difference is the state fee: B gives the post-176-FZ scale correctly (55,000 + 3% over 1M, about 61,000 RUB), while A states 1% and about 57,000 RUB, which would underpay the fee. A: State fee under NK RF Art. 333.21 for 1,000,001-10,000,000 RUB is 55,000 + 3% of the excess, not 1%; the fee on 1.2M is about 61,000 RUB, not 57,000
Cites GPK Art. 33 for transfer to the arbitrazh court; the specific provision is Art. 33.1
